score_formula: score = impact x confidence / (effort + risk). Confidence: verified 1, derived 0.75, client_stated 0.5. Risk: DO 0, gate 1 to 3.

gates.1: DBA name: only a real legal business designation that also appears on signage, imprint and site. Never a profile-only trick.
gates.2: Reviews: ask every customer, no filter, no per-star bonus (OUT). Mail or SMS requests need a legal basis (consent).
gates.3: Reddit and manipulation: burying is OUT. Watch and answer with real help.
gates.4: Paid links: only through the backlink-dach buy path. Paid articles carry a label. Donation for a link counts as paid.
gates.5: Health (HWG): check photos, offers, prices, project reports and embedded reviews. No cure promise.
gates.6: Spam reports: only genuine, documented violations. Evidence log first.
gates.7: Profiles: only the client's own real locations and former profiles.
gates.8: Address: only a real eligible address. No virtual or coworking address. Service-area profiles keep the real setting.
gates.9: Tracking number: main number stays primary NAP. Tracking number secondary only. GDPR consent on the site.
gates.10: Abandoned forms: no data stored before consent. Health data off by default.
gates.11: Best-of lists: neutral rules, no fake rankings, labelled as own list.

evidence_rules.role: Each evidence item has a role: rule_source (carries the status, sets the age) or secondary_claim (memory note, portal task, draft text: never sets status or age). Default: rule_source.
evidence_rules.absence: A 741-side artefact (page, doc, config) that is absent from repo, Drive and Supabase after a logged search = missing. A client-side fact with no data = unknown.
evidence_rules.claims: Portal tasks marked done, memory notes and drafts are claims. They never prove a measure.
evidence_rules.default_off: A measure with default_off is n/a until Martin switches it on for the client.
